newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Energy sets Indonesian drilling.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Energy sets Indonesian drilling.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources Inc said it expects the begin exploratory drilling this year on the Pagatan Block, an area of some 2.1 million acres along the southern coast of the Indonesian island of Kalimantan.
As announced by Pertamina last month, the state oil company signed a contract calling for Santa Fe to invest $25.7 million over 10 years to explore the area.

During the three year primary term of the contract Santa Fe Energy is obligated to drill at least one well, it said, adding the agreement provides for optional exploration extensions through ten years.

Santa Fe Energy said it intends to focus early attention on the offshore portion of the Pagatan Block by exploring its Akbar Prospect, a large prospect in shallow water. Subject to rig availability, the Company expects to drill the initial exploratory well there during 1997.
